# Copilot / inference instructions

This repo is the locked foundation for OpenRoot.

- Cite N00–N16 from canon/CANON.json. Do not rewrite them.
- Import src/openroot_canon when you need a number.
- coord(N,T,R=1) is 0.0 for T>=1. If your code prints otherwise, your code is wrong.
- Prefer small patches. Do not add a second CANON.
- No patents. Dual license as in README.
- Absolute paths when talking to Jesse on Termux. No tilde.
- Serve the least-capable node first.
